name: eval_quality_smoke_v1
description: Small curated synthetic smoke suite for category-aware eval metadata, grouped metrics, and focused agent-memory quality checks.
provenance: Hand-authored synthetic seed rows derived from existing Memory.swift eval patterns.
notes: This dataset is intentionally small and committed under Evals/ because it validates eval infrastructure and smoke behavior rather than broad model quality.
Do not add this suite to Evals/baselines/current.json until it has proven useful as a stable release-gate signal.
Rows use commercially safe synthetic project/user facts and avoid external benchmark answer strings.
